reason: My VA and I already live in Google Workspace: shared Gmail, Docs, Chat and one business calendar, and I'm already paying for it. Another $20 a month to move both of us into a new app solves a problem I don't really feel.
objection: Getting my assistant to switch apps is the hard part, and this doesn't replace Workspace, it sits on top of it, so we'd be paying twice and checking two places.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into our existing Google Calendar and Gmail so my VA could keep working where she is and the shared task view just appeared, with nothing to migrate.
